question: Which portal was launched by SIDBI to improve accessibility of credit and handholding services to MSMEs ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udyami Mitra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Udyami Mitra is a portal launched by the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) to improve accessibility of credit and handholding services to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).

• The portal facilitates MSMEs with credit and support services through a network of lenders and service providers.

• It also aims to bridge the gap between MSMEs and the formal financial ecosystem by enabling easy access to financial and non-financial services.

• Udyami Mitra provides information on various schemes and policies related to MSMEs, making it easier for entrepreneurs to avail the benefits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)**

• SIDBI is a development financial institution in India, headquartered in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

• It was established on April 2, 1990, through an Act of the Indian Parliament.

• The primary objective of SIDBI is to provide financial assistance to the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector in India.

• SIDBI plays a crucial role in the promotion, financing, and development of the MSME sector and coordinates the functions of institutions engaged in similar activities.

• **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)**

• MSMEs are the backbone of the Indian economy, significantly contributing to employment generation and GDP growth.

• As per the MSME Development Act, 2006, these enterprises are classified into micro, small, and medium based on their investment in plant and machinery or equipment.

• Micro enterprises have an investment of up to INR 1 crore and turnover of up to INR 5 crore.

• Small enterprises have an investment of up to INR 10 crore and turnover of up to INR 50 crore.

• Medium enterprises have an investment of up to INR 50 crore and turnover of up to INR 250 crore.

• **Credit and Handholding Services**

• Credit services refer to the provision of loans and financial products to MSMEs to support their business operations and growth.

• Handholding services include advisory, mentorship, and support services that help MSMEs navigate regulatory requirements, access market opportunities, and improve their business processes.

• These services are essential for the sustainability and growth of MSMEs, helping them overcome challenges and scale their operations.
